name: Activate Energy Acquisition Corp. Unit
summary: Activate Energy Acquisition Corp. (AEAQU) is focused on entering into various strategic business combinations, such as mergers, acquisitions, share exchanges, or reorganizations, with companies in the oil and gas sector. This entity was established in 2025 and has its principal operations located in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands. AEAQU operates as a subsidiary under the control of Activate Energy Sponsors LLC.
